content.title: Is Costco closed for Easter in Fresno? Save Mart? See which stores will be open
content.text: Save Mart Supermarket in Los Banos. Need to do some last-minute Easter shopping in Fresno?Some local businesses will shut their doors in observance of Easter Sunday in 2025, while other stores are observing special holiday hours. Here’s a list of what is open and closed in the Fresno area on Sunday, April 20 — from grocery stores and pharmacies to banks — as confirmed by The Fresno Bee.Holiday hours can differ by location. Be sure to check with your local store before heading out. Trader Joe’s store front taken on Nov 21, 2024. Fernanda Galan fgalan@fresnobee.com Which Fresno grocery stores are open on Easter? When?Are local pharmacies open on Easter Sunday?Here’s when local pharmacies are open and closed for Easter on Sunday, April 20:CVS: Store open 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Sunday; pharmacy open 10 a.m. to 6 p.m closed during lunch from 11:30 AM to 12:00 PM.Rite Aid: Store open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Sunday; pharmacy closed Walmart: Store open 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; pharmacy open 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.Walgreens: Store open 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. .; pharmacy 10:00 a.m. to 6 p.m. Target store front Fresno Monday, August 19, 2024 Fernanda Galan fgalan@fresnobee.com Are local shopping malls open on Easter?Most stores at Fresno’s River Park shopping center will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to its website. Fashion Fair in Fresno will also be closed on Sunday for the holiday.What else is closed on Easter in Fresno?Several Fresno-area government offices, including post offices and public libraries, and most banks are closed for Easter on Sunday.Commercial package delivery companies UPS and FedEx will also be closed on Sunday. Fernanda Galan covers Central Valley and California news as The Fresno Bee’s service journalism reporter. Before joining The Bee in 2024, she reported in Milwaukee, Arizona and Los Angeles. She is a graduate of Arizona State’s Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication.
